name: Microsoft Workloads Lens
description: This lens provides AWS customers with a set of Well-Architected best practices and guidance on cloud-based architectures for Microsoft workloads including Windows Server, SQL Server, Active Directory, and .NET applications.

questions.title: How do you implement monitoring and observability for your Microsoft workload?
questions.description: Monitor your Microsoft workload so that you have visibility over its state. You should consider mechanisms across all components to provide real-time monitoring and logging to allow predictability and remediation.

choices.title: Implement infrastructure monitoring for your Microsoft workload

helpfulResource.displayText: The implementation of infrastructure monitoring for Microsoft workloads on AWS will provide comprehensive visibility into system performance, resource utilization, and application health. This monitoring solution will detect anomalies in real time, generate actionable alerts, and enable rapid troubleshooting of issues before they impact end users. Consider leveraging Microsoft Performance Counters to cover the basic infrastructure monitoring for your Microsoft workload servers.

improvementPlan.displayText: Implement infrastructure monitoring for your Microsoft workload

choices.title: Implement and collect logging for your Microsoft workload

helpfulResource.displayText: Set up logs for your Microsoft workload infrastructure and applications. Windows Event Logs are natively generated by the Windows operating system and usually by the applications deployed. Products such as SQL Server and Internet Information Services (IIS) also provide text logs that can bring insights to observability. Both Windows Event Logs and custom logs can be collected by Amazon CloudWatch Agent and have them centralized in the Amazon CloudWatch console.

improvementPlan.displayText: Implement and collect logging for your Microsoft workload

choices.title: Implement Application Performance Monitoring (APM) for your Microsoft workload

helpfulResource.displayText: Microsoft workloads developed with .NET and SQL technologies should also have Application Performance Monitoring (APM) implemented. Amazon CloudWatch Application Insights for .NET and SQL Server can be used for that purpose. AWS X-Ray can be used as well to improve traceability over the workload.

improvementPlan.displayText: Implement Application Performance Monitoring (APM) for your Microsoft workload

choices.title: None of these

helpfulResource.displayText: Choose this if your workload does not follow these best practices.

questions.title: How do you implement operational automation for your Microsoft workload?
questions.description: Safely automate your Microsoft workload from the infrastructure to the application layer, where possible, to limit human error and apply consistent engineering patterns.

choices.title: Implement Management and Governance solutions

helpfulResource.displayText: Set up Management and Governance solutions to ensure your Microsoft workload is patched and compliant with your security requirements. AWS Systems Manager functions as an operations hub for your workload, addressing fleet management, compliance, inventory, admin session management, state management, patch management, and running remote commands or scripts.

improvementPlan.displayText: Implement Management and Governance solutions

choices.title: Implement infrastructure deployment and update automation for your Microsoft workload

helpfulResource.displayText: Set up Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to apply patterns to the infrastructure of your Microsoft workload. You can use AWS CloudFormation to help model and deploy the required AWS resources based on templates. Third-party solutions, such as Terraform, are also useful for the case.

improvementPlan.displayText: Implement infrastructure deployment and update automation for your Microsoft workload

choices.title: Implement operating system image control

helpfulResource.displayText: AWS has developed a set of Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) for popular Microsoft solutions with License Included software, enabling standardized and automated deployments of Windows Server instances in Amazon EC2. You can either use the latest images that are built by AWS or create your own. EC2 Image Builder is a fully managed AWS service that helps you to automate the creation, management, and deployment of customized, secure, and up-to-date server images.

improvementPlan.displayText: Implement operating system image control

choices.title: Leverage managed services for your Microsoft workload

helpfulResource.displayText: To reduce operational overhead, implement the use of AWS managed services to address your Microsoft workload requirements. Consider AWS Managed Microsoft Active Directory, Amazon Relational Database Service for SQL Server, Amazon FSx for Windows File Server, Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, and others.

improvementPlan.displayText: Leverage managed services for your Microsoft workload

choices.title: None of these

helpfulResource.displayText: Choose this if your workload does not follow these best practices.

questions.title: How do you secure your Microsoft workload, including its database, operating system, and underlying infrastructure?
questions.description: It's important to harden Microsoft applications and their underlying components, including operating systems, databases, cloud services, and infrastructure. This hardening should be applied to Microsoft environments, both production and non-production, at levels appropriate to your organization's needs.

choices.title: Protect the operating system

helpfulResource.displayText: Securing the operating system that hosts your Microsoft application is crucial in blocking unauthorized access, securing software availability, and maintaining the stability of your critical systems. By following Microsoft and AWS recommendations for Windows Server environments, you can reduce the risk of malicious attacks.

improvementPlan.displayText: Protect the operating system

choices.title: Secure the Microsoft application and database

helpfulResource.displayText: Maintaining strong security at both the database and application layers is crucial, as even read-only access by malicious actors could compromise critical business data. To protect your Microsoft environment, implement security best practices including the least access principle, least privilege model, encryption at rest, and encryption in transit.

improvementPlan.displayText: Secure the Microsoft application and database

choices.title: Develop a comprehensive software update strategy

helpfulResource.displayText: Microsoft regularly releases scheduled security updates and emergency patches to address vulnerabilities. Stay informed about the latest security advisories from relevant vendors. It's crucial to keep your Microsoft application and its underlying components up-to-date with the latest security fixes on a regular schedule to avoid security gaps.

improvementPlan.displayText: Develop a comprehensive software update strategy

choices.title: None of these

helpfulResource.displayText: Choose this if your workload does not follow these best practices.

questions.title: How do you manage and regulate user access to your Microsoft workload environment?
questions.description: To control access to your Microsoft workload, utilize the authentication and authorization tools provided by AWS, Microsoft, and trusted third-party vendors. Implement a least-privilege approach, verifying that users and systems have only the permissions necessary for their roles.

choices.title: Align your Microsoft workload access with organizational identity strategy

helpfulResource.displayText: Microsoft workloads, including .NET applications and SQL Server environments, typically integrate with Active Directory (AD) or similar identity management systems. A centralized approach to user management, regardless of the specific solution, can significantly reduce security risks and operational complexity.

improvementPlan.displayText: Align your Microsoft workload access with organizational identity strategy

choices.title: Implement logging to track access and authorization changes

helpfulResource.displayText: Regularly log, analyze, and audit user access and authorization events in your Microsoft systems. Consolidate security events from Microsoft applications and databases with other architectural components to enable comprehensive tracing during security incidents.

improvementPlan.displayText: Implement logging to track access and authorization changes

choices.title: None of these

helpfulResource.displayText: Choose this if your workload does not follow these best practices.

questions.title: How do you protect your Microsoft workload data?
questions.description: Whether using Microsoft SQL Server or other solutions, it's best practice to encrypt data both at rest and in transit, employing multiple encryption mechanisms to meet internal and external security requirements.

choices.title: Encrypt data stored in Microsoft workloads

helpfulResource.displayText: Data at rest encompasses the entirety of your digitally stored information. Encryption is crucial to verify that this data remains visible only to authorized users and stays protected, even if storage or database access is compromised independently of the application. For Microsoft SQL Server environments, consider implementing Transparent Data Encryption (TDE).

improvementPlan.displayText: Encrypt data stored in Microsoft workloads

choices.title: Enable Always Encrypted feature for SQL Server

helpfulResource.displayText: Microsoft SQL Server's Always Encrypted feature provides robust data protection using client-side encryption with certificates. This technology creates a clear separation between data owners who can view the information and data managers who shouldn't have access.

improvementPlan.displayText: Enable Always Encrypted feature for SQL Server

choices.title: Use Trusted Platform Module (TPM) technology for hardware-based security on your instances

helpfulResource.displayText: The AWS Nitro Trusted Platform Module (NitroTPM) is a virtual TPM 2.0 device that's fully integrated with the AWS Nitro System, providing hardware-based security features for EC2 instances running Windows Server 2016 and later, as well as supported Linux distributions.

improvementPlan.displayText: Use Trusted Platform Module (TPM) technology for hardware-based security on your instances

choices.title: None of these

helpfulResource.displayText: Choose this if your workload does not follow these best practices.

questions.title: How do you design your Microsoft workload to withstand failure?
questions.description: To create a resilient Microsoft infrastructure on AWS, define business requirements and availability goals, assess failure scenarios, and determine recovery needs. Choose and evaluate an appropriate architecture pattern, then implement and test regularly.

choices.title: Define availability goals for Microsoft workloads

helpfulResource.displayText: Identifying your organization's specific availability objectives is crucial as it guides your focus towards critical factors. This clarity enables you to establish relevant criteria for assessing and selecting the most appropriate architectural patterns for your workload.

improvementPlan.displayText: Define availability goals for Microsoft workloads

choices.title: Align your architectural design with your availability needs and capacity demands

helpfulResource.displayText: There are architecture recommendations regarding Microsoft workloads, whether addressing Windows infrastructure, Active Directory, SQL Server databases, .NET applications, or other technologies. Review the vendor recommendations along with AWS documentation to verify that your application is running with best practices to improve availability and resiliency.

improvementPlan.displayText: Align your architectural design with your availability needs and capacity demands

choices.title: Safeguard the continuous accessibility of essential data from your Microsoft workload

helpfulResource.displayText: Microsoft workloads encompass diverse technologies including SQL Server databases, Active Directory domain controllers, Exchange Server mailbox databases, SharePoint content databases, IIS web applications, and Windows file servers, each requiring specialized backup and recovery approaches.

improvementPlan.displayText: Safeguard the continuous accessibility of essential data from your Microsoft workload

choices.title: None of these

helpfulResource.displayText: Choose this if your workload does not follow these best practices.

questions.title: What methods and systems do you have in place to identify and respond to disruptions affecting your Microsoft workload?
questions.description: Design resilient Microsoft workloads through targeted solutions and monitoring systems that detect and stop failures. Assess infrastructure components, identify vulnerabilities, and implement protective measures. Regular testing and automation help maintain system health and adaptability to challenges.

choices.title: Implement comprehensive monitoring for potential failures across the application, AWS infrastructure, and network connectivity

helpfulResource.displayText: Monitoring your Microsoft application, AWS resources, and network connectivity enables prompt responses to both actual and potential failures, enhancing overall system reliability.

improvementPlan.displayText: Implement comprehensive monitoring for potential failures across the application, AWS infrastructure, and network connectivity

choices.title: Develop a strategic plan for quickly reinstating service availability during outages

helpfulResource.displayText: Microsoft workloads require specialized disaster recovery strategies due to their unique architectural dependencies and state management requirements. SQL Server Always On Availability Groups, Active Directory domain controllers, Exchange Database Availability Groups, and Windows Failover Clusters each have specific recovery procedures.

improvementPlan.displayText: Develop a strategic plan for quickly reinstating service availability during outages

choices.title: None of these

helpfulResource.displayText: Choose this if your workload does not follow these best practices.

questions.title: How do you address post-incident analysis and continuous improvement?
questions.description: Post-incident analysis and continuous improvement are essential for managing Microsoft workloads on AWS. Organizations analyze incidents to extract insights and implement preventive measures, helping them avoid similar issues and strengthen their operational resilience.

choices.title: Use Microsoft logs for incident analysis

helpfulResource.displayText: Microsoft workloads generate rich diagnostic information through specialized logging systems that provide deeper visibility into application behavior, security events, and system performance than standard infrastructure monitoring alone.

improvementPlan.displayText: Use Microsoft logs for incident analysis

choices.title: Establish a structured review process that combines insights from both AWS and Microsoft monitoring tools

helpfulResource.displayText: Document lessons learned in a centralized knowledge base, update incident response playbooks, and conduct regular tabletop exercises to validate improvements. Configure automated reporting to track incident metrics and measure the effectiveness of implemented changes.

improvementPlan.displayText: Establish a structured review process that combines insights from both AWS and Microsoft monitoring tools

choices.title: Implement automated feedback loops

helpfulResource.displayText: Automated feedback loops are critical for Microsoft workloads due to their complex interdependencies and the need for continuous monitoring of performance patterns, security posture, and operational effectiveness.

improvementPlan.displayText: Implement automated feedback loops

choices.title: None of these

helpfulResource.displayText: Choose this if your workload does not follow these best practices.

questions.title: How do you address capacity management and auto scaling?
questions.description: Capacity management and auto scaling for Microsoft workloads on AWS optimize performance and costs by automatically adjusting resources based on demand, while considering Microsoft-specific requirements and AWS capabilities.

choices.title: Use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling in combination with Application Auto Scaling

helpfulResource.displayText: Microsoft workloads often experience variable demand patterns that require dynamic resource scaling to maintain performance and cost efficiency. Applications like SharePoint farms, SQL Server databases, and .NET web applications face fluctuating user loads, batch processing requirements, and seasonal traffic variations.

improvementPlan.displayText: Use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling in combination with Application Auto Scaling

choices.title: None of these

helpfulResource.displayText: Choose this if your workload does not follow these best practices.

questions.title: How do you implement recovery automation for your Microsoft workload?
questions.description: Recovery automation for Microsoft workloads on AWS combines AWS capabilities with Microsoft-specific tools to maintain business continuity. This practice focuses on automated approaches to protect and recover Microsoft-based applications and infrastructure on AWS, minimizing downtime and human intervention.

choices.title: Implement disaster recovery automation

helpfulResource.displayText: Disaster recovery (DR) automation is essential for Microsoft workloads due to their complex interdependencies and stateful nature. Microsoft environments often involve intricate relationships between Active Directory, SQL Server databases, file services, and application servers that require coordinated recovery procedures.

improvementPlan.displayText: Implement disaster recovery automation

choices.title: Implement backup automation

helpfulResource.displayText: Backup automation is critical for Microsoft workloads running on AWS, maintaining consistent data protection without manual intervention. Microsoft applications like SQL Server, Exchange, and SharePoint require application-aware backup strategies that maintain data integrity and support reliable recovery scenarios.

improvementPlan.displayText: Implement backup automation

choices.title: Implement self-healing procedures

helpfulResource.displayText: Establish automated remediation capabilities that can detect, diagnose, and resolve common issues in Microsoft workloads without human intervention. Self-healing procedures reduce mean time to recovery (MTTR) and minimize the impact of transient failures on business operations.

improvementPlan.displayText: Implement self-healing procedures

choices.title: Implement testing automation

helpfulResource.displayText: Establish comprehensive automated testing frameworks that continuously validate the reliability and recoverability of Microsoft workloads on AWS. Testing automation verifies that disaster recovery (DR) procedures, backup systems, and failover mechanisms work as expected when needed.

improvementPlan.displayText: Implement testing automation

choices.title: None of these

helpfulResource.displayText: Choose this if your workload does not follow these best practices.

questions.title: How do you select the appropriate cloud resources for your Microsoft workload architecture?
questions.description: It is not unusual to have multiple cloud solutions to address your Microsoft workload architecture needs. Evaluate the cloud resources that better fit your workload following the AWS Well-Architected recommendations.

choices.title: Consider AWS Elastic Beanstalk for running traditional Windows servers hosting your Microsoft application

helpfulResource.displayText: In scenarios where the traditional virtual machine approach is a requirement, evaluate the EC2 instance families that better address your Microsoft workload needs. Using data-driven decisions for architectural considerations, you can also opt for Elastic Beanstalk to reduce the operational overhead on managing the EC2 instances and surrounding infrastructure resources.

improvementPlan.displayText: Consider AWS Elastic Beanstalk for running traditional Windows servers hosting your Microsoft application

choices.title: Consider Amazon managed container orchestrator services to run containers on AWS

helpfulResource.displayText: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS), and AWS Fargate support both Linux and Windows containers. Either running cross-platform .NET on Linux or .NET Framework on Windows, you can run your Microsoft container-compatible workload taking advantage of the benefits of the managed service.

improvementPlan.displayText: Consider Amazon managed container orchestrator services to run containers on AWS

choices.title: Run serverless Microsoft applications on AWS Lambda

helpfulResource.displayText: Use cases such as event-driven, like message processing and API routes, application-based function, like packaging and entire cross-platform ASP.NET runtime, file processing, mobile backend, cloud automation, and similar are usually suitable for running on AWS Lambda.

improvementPlan.displayText: Run serverless Microsoft applications on AWS Lambda

choices.title: None of these

helpfulResource.displayText: Choose this if your workload does not follow these best practices.

questions.title: How do you select the appropriate compute resources and features for your Microsoft workloads running on Windows servers?
questions.description: Amazon EC2 provides scalability, flexibility, and cost efficiency resources that can apply to Windows EC2 instances. Appropriate instance families and EC2 features can be used by your Windows machines to bring the performance efficiency needed by your workload.

choices.title: Choose the Amazon EC2 instance families that best fit the Microsoft workload

helpfulResource.displayText: Amazon EC2 provides different instance family types, addressing different purposes. For example, General purpose instances, such as m7i and m7a can be used for most production applications running on Windows Server. Memory optimized instances, such as r7i, r7a, and x2iedn provide greater ratio of memory to vCPU and are ideal for memory-intensive workloads, such as Microsoft SQL Server.

improvementPlan.displayText: Choose the Amazon EC2 instance families that best fit the Microsoft workload

choices.title: Consider the use for EC2 Fast Launch to accelerate launching your Microsoft workload instances

helpfulResource.displayText: EC2 Fast Launch will speed up the Windows EC2 instance launch process. When you configure a Windows Server AMI for EC2 Fast Launch, Amazon EC2 creates a set of pre-provisioned snapshots to use for faster launching.

improvementPlan.displayText: Consider the use for EC2 Fast Launch to accelerate launching your Microsoft workload instances

choices.title: Consider using Amazon EBS fast snapshot restore

helpfulResource.displayText: Amazon EBS Fast Snapshot Restore (FSR) offers significant advantages for Microsoft workloads by eliminating the initialization latency typically associated with first-use EBS volumes created from snapshots.

improvementPlan.displayText: Consider using Amazon EBS fast snapshot restore

choices.title: Consider using Amazon EBS Provisioned Rate for Volume Initialization

helpfulResource.displayText: Amazon EBS provisioned rate for volume initialization (PRVI) offers significant advantages for Microsoft workloads by providing predictable and faster initialization times for new EBS volumes created from snapshots.

improvementPlan.displayText: Consider using Amazon EBS Provisioned Rate for Volume Initialization

choices.title: None of these

helpfulResource.displayText: Choose this if your workload does not follow these best practices.

questions.title: How do you select the appropriate storage solutions for your Microsoft workloads running on Windows servers?
questions.description: AWS offers different storage options that can address different needs for your Microsoft workloads. Appropriate storage options can be used by your Windows machines to bring the performance efficiency needed by your workload.

choices.title: Consider Amazon EBS gp3 volumes for general workloads

helpfulResource.displayText: Amazon EBS's newest and most cost-effective SSD option, General Purpose SSD (gp3) volumes, strikes an optimal balance between price and performance for a wide range of applications. A key advantage of gp3 volumes is the ability to adjust performance independently of storage capacity.

improvementPlan.displayText: Consider Amazon EBS gp3 volumes for general workloads

choices.title: Consider Amazon EBS io2 Block Express volumes for high-intense I/O workloads

helpfulResource.displayText: Amazon EBS io2 Block Express volumes are based on an updated storage server architecture. They are designed to handle high I/O requirements for applications running on Nitro System-based instances.

improvementPlan.displayText: Consider Amazon EBS io2 Block Express volumes for high-intense I/O workloads

choices.title: Consider Amazon FSx for Windows File Server

helpfulResource.displayText: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server is a managed service that provides file storage using Microsoft Windows file system technology. It supports Windows file system features and uses the Server Message Block (SMB) protocol for network file access.

improvementPlan.displayText: Consider Amazon FSx for Windows File Server

choices.title: Consider Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP

helpfulResource.displayText: Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP is a fully managed AWS service that provides scalable, high-performance file storage based on the widely-used NetApp ONTAP file system.

improvementPlan.displayText: Consider Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP

choices.title: Leverage instance store temporary block storage for EC2 instances

helpfulResource.displayText: An instance store is a form of temporary block-level storage for EC2 instances, provided by disks physically attached to the host computer. It is well-suited for storing frequently changing data such as buffers, caches, and scratch data.

improvementPlan.displayText: Leverage instance store temporary block storage for EC2 instances

choices.title: None of these

helpfulResource.displayText: Choose this if your workload does not follow these best practices.

questions.title: How do you measure performance requirements changes and anomalies?
questions.description: Determine your Microsoft workload's typical operational metrics by analyzing past performance data. Configure notification systems to alert IT personnel when significant variations from these norms occur. Create and document protocols for technical staff to rectify such anomalies.

choices.title: Use historical data to evaluate performance

helpfulResource.displayText: Effective assessment of Microsoft workload performance requires comprehensive data collection across key system components: compute, memory, storage, and networking. By monitoring these critical areas, organizations can identify suboptimal performance and implement timely corrective measures.

improvementPlan.displayText: Use historical data to evaluate performance

choices.title: Define baseline performance requirements

helpfulResource.displayText: Microsoft workloads vary in their performance needs, making historical data analysis crucial for establishing baseline performance metrics. This approach allows organizations to detect and quantify performance fluctuations effectively.

improvementPlan.displayText: Define baseline performance requirements

choices.title: None of these

helpfulResource.displayText: Choose this if your workload does not follow these best practices.

questions.title: How comprehensively have you assessed your Microsoft workload environment?
questions.description: It is important to have the complete picture of your workload. Taking this first step ensures your applications are using right-sized resources. Gathering licensing information may also be aided by this.

choices.title: Run discovery tools

helpfulResource.displayText: Migration Evaluator is a migration assessment service that helps you create a directional business case for AWS cloud planning and migration. AWS Application Discovery Service helps you plan cloud migration projects, by gathering information about your on-premises data centers.

improvementPlan.displayText: Run discovery tools

choices.title: Run assessment tools

helpfulResource.displayText: AWS Optimization and Licensing Assessment (OLA) is a complimentary program for new and existing customers to assess and optimize current on-premises and cloud environments, based on actual resource utilization, third-party licensing, and application dependencies.

improvementPlan.displayText: Run assessment tools

choices.title: Run platform-specific tools

helpfulResource.displayText: Platform-specific tools, such as Azure Resource Discovery Tool, are useful for environment understanding. This is a PowerShell script provided by AWS that generates an inventory report including detailed metrics of an Azure environment.

improvementPlan.displayText: Run platform-specific tools

choices.title: None of these

helpfulResource.displayText: Choose this if your workload does not follow these best practices.

questions.title: How do you save on Windows EC2 costs?
questions.description: Amazon EC2 provides scalability, flexibility, and cost efficiency resources that can apply to Windows EC2 instances.

choices.title: Right size Windows instances

helpfulResource.displayText: AWS Compute Optimizer uses machine learning to analyze the performance metrics and utilization patterns of Microsoft workloads running on AWS, including Windows Server instances and SQL Server deployments.

improvementPlan.displayText: Right size Windows instances

choices.title: Automate stop and start schedules

helpfulResource.displayText: Leverage the Instance Scheduler on AWS to reduce the use of Amazon EC2 and Amazon Relational Database Service instances that do not need to run continuously.

improvementPlan.displayText: Automate stop and start schedules

choices.title: Bring Your Own Licenses (BYOL)

helpfulResource.displayText: If you have already invested in licenses for your Microsoft workload, such as having enterprise licensing agreements, you can choose to bring your own licenses to AWS and save costs on EC2.

improvementPlan.displayText: Bring Your Own Licenses (BYOL)

choices.title: None of these

helpfulResource.displayText: Choose this if your workload does not follow these best practices.

questions.title: How do you save on SQL Server costs?
questions.description: AWS offers different options to run Microsoft SQL Server and leverage existing licenses.

choices.title: Understand Microsoft SQL Server licensing and BYOL availability

helpfulResource.displayText: AWS offers a range of flexible cost optimization choices for licensing. These licensing options are designed to help you reduce costs, maintain compliance, and meet your business needs.

improvementPlan.displayText: Understand Microsoft SQL Server licensing and BYOL availability

choices.title: Consolidate Microsoft SQL Server instances

helpfulResource.displayText: A SQL instance is part of the SQL Server Database Engine, that provides the SQL service to clients or applications. For smaller or non-critical workloads organizations can leverage shared resources and have multiple SQL instances installed on the same server.

improvementPlan.displayText: Consolidate Microsoft SQL Server instances

choices.title: Check if your workload is running with the right SQL Server edition

helpfulResource.displayText: Microsoft offers types of SQL Server editions, with a different set of features and license cost. Over the release of SQL versions, Microsoft has added more features to the Standard edition.

improvementPlan.displayText: Check if your workload is running with the right SQL Server edition

choices.title: Evaluate SQL Server Developer edition

helpfulResource.displayText: SQL Server Developer edition includes all functionality of the Enterprise edition. It is a free edition that can be used in non-production environments.

improvementPlan.displayText: Evaluate SQL Server Developer edition

choices.title: Evaluate SQL Server on Linux

helpfulResource.displayText: Beginning on SQL Server 2017, Microsoft offers the option to run SQL Server on Linux operating systems. You can switch from SQL Server on Windows Server to SQL Server on Linux to save on Windows Server licensing costs.

improvementPlan.displayText: Evaluate SQL Server on Linux

choices.title: Evaluate Optimize CPU feature

helpfulResource.displayText: Optimize CPUs for Amazon EC2 Instances provides customers greater control of your EC2 instances. You can specify a custom number of vCPUs to save on vCPU-based licensing costs (such as SQL Server).

improvementPlan.displayText: Evaluate Optimize CPU feature

choices.title: None of these

helpfulResource.displayText: Choose this if your workload does not follow these best practices.

questions.title: How do you modernize your Microsoft SQL Server workloads?
questions.description: When embarking on a journey to modernize legacy databases for improved scalability, performance, and cost optimization, organizations often face challenges with commercial databases like SQL Server. Migrating to open-source databases offers a viable solution.

choices.title: Use caching to enhance SQL Server workloads

helpfulResource.displayText: Caching in .NET applications reduces costs and improves performance by storing frequently accessed data, lowering the load on backend databases like SQL Server.

improvementPlan.displayText: Use caching to enhance SQL Server workloads

choices.title: Consider Babelfish for Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL

helpfulResource.displayText: Babelfish is an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL feature that allows SQL Server client applications to connect directly to PostgreSQL databases. It works by understanding SQL Server's TDS protocol and common SQL statements.

improvementPlan.displayText: Consider Babelfish for Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL

choices.title: Consider purpose-built databases

helpfulResource.displayText: Purpose-built databases are gaining traction among businesses adopting modern architectures like microservices, as they can precisely accommodate specific data access patterns.

improvementPlan.displayText: Consider purpose-built databases

choices.title: None of these

helpfulResource.displayText: Choose this if your workload does not follow these best practices.

questions.title: How do you save on storage for your Microsoft workload?
questions.description: The storage layer is a critical architecture component for most applications, including Microsoft workloads. Exploring the compatible Amazon storage offers can help you provide the required performance to your workloads and save costs.

choices.title: Migrate Amazon EBS volumes from gp2 to gp3

helpfulResource.displayText: General Purpose SSD (gp3) volumes are the latest generation of General Purpose SSD volumes, and the lowest cost SSD volume offered by Amazon EBS. This volume type helps to provide the right balance of price and performance.

improvementPlan.displayText: Migrate Amazon EBS volumes from gp2 to gp3

choices.title: Control Amazon EBS volumes or snapshots lifecycle

helpfulResource.displayText: EBS snapshots are incremental backups stored in S3, saving only changed blocks since the last snapshot. Managing snapshot lifecycles and removing unused volumes helps optimize costs.

improvementPlan.displayText: Control Amazon EBS volumes or snapshots lifecycle

choices.title: Use Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP

helpfulResource.displayText: Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP offers a file system that supports SMB and iSCSI protocols. Useful for critical Microsoft SQL Server environments, as ONTAP volumes can be mapped to Windows Server instances as block storage devices.

improvementPlan.displayText: Use Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP

choices.title: Use Amazon FSx for Windows File Server

helpfulResource.displayText: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server is a fully managed file storage service that's optimized for Microsoft workloads. It provides an SMB file system that can be accessed by applications.

improvementPlan.displayText: Use Amazon FSx for Windows File Server

choices.title: None of these

helpfulResource.displayText: Choose this if your workload does not follow these best practices.

questions.title: How do you save on Active Directory for your Microsoft workload?
questions.description: Microsoft Active Directory has been a widely used identity management solution in Windows networks for decades. When deploying Active Directory on AWS, consider the options to make sure you are saving on direct or operational costs for your Microsoft workload.

choices.title: Use AWS Managed Microsoft Active Directory

helpfulResource.displayText: AWS Managed Microsoft AD provides redundant Windows Server domain controllers across two Availability Zones in your VPC. It handles all maintenance tasks automatically, including monitoring, replication, backups, and updates.

improvementPlan.displayText: Use AWS Managed Microsoft Active Directory

choices.title: Use AD Connector

helpfulResource.displayText: AD Connector is a directory gateway with which you can redirect directory requests to your on-premises Microsoft Active Directory without caching any information in the cloud.

improvementPlan.displayText: Use AD Connector

choices.title: Use self-managed Active Directory on Amazon EC2

helpfulResource.displayText: Depending on the requirements, your Microsoft workload may require the use of a self-managed Active Directory deployment. Domain controllers are usually good candidates to run on Amazon EC2 burstable instance family, saving on compute costs.

improvementPlan.displayText: Use self-managed Active Directory on Amazon EC2

choices.title: None of these

helpfulResource.displayText: Choose this if your workload does not follow these best practices.

questions.title: How do you save on Windows Server footprint moving to Windows Containers?
questions.description: Containers can help optimize the infrastructure and also promote agility for your workloads. If compatible, applications that require components from the Windows OS may leverage the infrastructure modernization of running on Windows containers.

choices.title: Optimize AWS Fargate tasks with AWS Compute Optimizer

helpfulResource.displayText: AWS Compute Optimizer can be used to help right size and optimize your workloads running on AWS Fargate. If not reviewed, long running tasks can be overprovisioned and increase compute costs.

improvementPlan.displayText: Optimize AWS Fargate tasks with AWS Compute Optimizer

choices.title: Improve Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service cost tracking with Kubecost

helpfulResource.displayText: Kubecost improves the cost tracking for your Windows containers. Kubecost helps right sizing cluster nodes, container requests, and manages underutilized infrastructure.

improvementPlan.displayText: Improve Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service cost tracking with Kubecost

choices.title: Change your scale strategy for Windows Containers on Kubernetes using Karpenter

helpfulResource.displayText: Karpenter is a Kubernetes cluster autoscaler that dynamically provisions EC2 instances based on your workload demands, automatically launching right-sized instances in response to pending pods.

improvementPlan.displayText: Change your scale strategy for Windows Containers on Kubernetes using Karpenter

choices.title: None of these

questions.description: While .NET Framework applications often utilize AWS virtual machines or containers, cross-platform .NET's introduction enables modern applications to fully exploit cloud benefits, including serverless environments.

choices.title: Refactor to cross-platform .NET and move to Linux

helpfulResource.displayText: Migrating .NET Framework applications to .NET 8 or later enables cross-platform deployment, improved security, and better performance. This modernization allows applications to run on Linux systems.
